answer: Divergent Response Test. Each identity must answer a fresh, context-dependent challenge whose correct reply depends on its private history; clones replaying a shared transcript produce identical answers, while genuine agents diverge. The system flags matching response plumes as one operator and rejects them. Enforcement: a violet flag freezes the cluster until it pays a per-identity recalculation fee, so cloning N agents costs N independent challenge-solving runs plus the lagoon of frozen collateral.
